properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.3 is a real shipped dev dependency — the SHA-1/SHA-2 engine used by elliptic@6.5.4 (ECDSA internals) and ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 in the ganache/ethereum-waffle toolchain. No direct application call site (the app hashes via ethers' keccak256), but it ships with the build's node_modules. Changeable here via lockfile upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 8 sites are lockfile references to the secp256k1 npm package (v4 native binding) and @types/secp256k1, required by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (line 2204-2220) in the ganache/ethereum-waffle dev chain. ECDSA over secp256k1 is THE Ethereum signature algorithm — Shor-vulnerable. The repo replays historical mainnet hacks, so the algorithm is protocol-fixed: observable here, replaceable only by the Ethereum protocol itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 6 sites are lockfile references to evp_bytestokey@1.x — OpenSSL's legacy single-iteration MD5 KDF — required by browserify-aes@1.2.0 (line 1482) and browserify-cipher@1.0.1 (line 4140) inside the crypto-browserify tree of the ganache/ethereum-waffle dev toolchain. Retroactively weak KDF (MD5, one round); no application call site, but it ships in node_modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lockfile dependency inventory: bcrypt-pbkdf (BIP39-compatible PBKDF2 over bcrypt's Blowfish-based PRF) ships in the installed tree as a transitive dep of the hardhat/waffle dev toolchain (the project's crypto deps are devDependencies per package.json). No call site in application code; presence is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 3 sites are lockfile references to create-ecdh@4, the browserify ECDH polyfill inside the crypto-browserify tree (ganache/ethereum-waffle dev chain). No application ECDH use — this repo's key operations are Ethereum secp256k1 ECDSA — but the capability ships in the build. Changeable here via lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature primitive available via tweetnacl@1.0.3 (resolved block at package-lock.json:2178, dev). No Ed25519 call site in application code — the app signs with secp256k1 ECDSA via ethers; this is the shipped-capability tier of the inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is the live ECDSA engine inside ethers.js v5 (@ethersproject/signing-key): every transaction this repo's tests sign, and the HDNode-derived account keys in tasks/accounts.ts, go through ECDSA/secp256k1 in this library. The repo's core quantum-vulnerable primitive. Ethereum protocol-fixed — observable here, not replaceable by this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 is required by eth-sig-util@2.5.4 (line 2159) in the ethereum-waffle/ganache chain; it provides X25519 (box) alongside Ed25519 and XSalsa20-Poly1305. No application call site — the app never does X25519 — but the capability ships in the dev toolchain. Shor-vulnerable if ever used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 23 sites are lockfile references to @ethersproject/keccak256 (ethers v5's Keccak-256 module, used for address derivation, tx hashes, function selectors) and keccak@3.x (native binding, used by ethereum-cryptography/ganache). Ethereum's keccak256 is protocol-fixed. Grover square-root only — hashes are not urgent for PQ. Additional carriers of this same asset: js-sha3@0.5.7/0.8.0 entries at lines 67, 2197, 6100, 7918, 11972, 12645 (eth-ens-namehash, @ethersproject/solidity).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 availability in the build: @ethersproject/pbkdf2 5.0.8 is what ethers.js 5.0.31 uses to turn a BIP39 mnemonic into a seed (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations) for HDNode — the derivation chain this repo exercises at tasks/accounts.ts:23 and via the hardcoded config mnemonic. Standalone pbkdf2 3.0.x ships the same KDF for the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 7 sites are lockfile references to scrypt-js@3.x — the scrypt KDF ethers.js uses for Web3 Secret Storage (encrypted JSON keystore) files; required by @ethersproject/json-wallets (line 409) and ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (line 2221). No keystore file exists in the repo itself; the capability ships in the dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 (required by eth-sig-util@2.5.4, line 2159) ships the XSalsa20-Poly1305-256 secretbox authenticated cipher. No application call site — recorded as a shipped AE capability in the dev toolchain. Symmetric primitive, not Shor-relevant; strength is fine.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NaCl crypto library (Ed25519, X25519 scalar-mult, XSalsa20-Poly1305 secretbox, SHA-512) shipped transitively in the dev toolchain via the eth-sig-util-style package requiring tweetnacl ^1.0.3 alongside ethereumjs-util 5.2.1 (which itself pulls elliptic for secp256k1). No application call sites; capability-presence tier.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt KDF package (n=131072/r=8/p=1 profile via ethers) shipped as the dependency of @ethersproject/scrypt, which powers ethers v5's keystore-file encryption (ethers v5.0.31 is the app's crypto provider). No keystore call site in this repo; capability-presence tier.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Streamable SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512 hashing, shipped as the hash backend for @ethersproject/sha2 (ethers v5's SHA-2 support, used in keystore KDF/SHA256 checksums) and create-hash in the toolchain. Capability-presence tier; no direct application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The elliptic@6.5.4 package entry — the same shipped library that ALG-710f61f0 records as this repo's ECDSA signing engine (ethers.js v5 @ethersproject/signing-key). Same logical asset under two names; folding so a reader references one entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hash library (MD5, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1/SHA-2 families) shipped as the pinned dependency of elliptic 6.x (lock line 511: "hash.js": "1.1.3"), which implements the secp256k1 ECDSA behind ethers v5 — the app's crypto provider. Capability-presence tier.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The pbkdf2 npm package (3.1.x entries; top-level 3.1.2 at line 13821) is the PBKDF2 implementation of this lockfile — required by ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 and the crypto-browserify tree, and used by ethers.js for keystore-file PBKDF2 (Web3 Secret Storage KDF). Same logical asset as the PBKDF2 algorithm object ALG-4de3b020; folding so a reader references one entry.
